claim: Patchline ships an economic field study monetizing incident reductions with confidence intervals. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the confidence interval claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make economic-field-study-gate`.
